controls.observed: The exact-head service regression rejects missing scoped references, inactive services and child services, and accepts only the explicit current inactive-service exception through the canonical eligibility rule.

retired_controls.procedure: Re-evaluate the historical control disposition against the current requirement closure and current material candidate.
retired_controls.expected: The historical control remains explicitly superseded by its active replacement or demonstrably not applicable under the current canonical requirement closure.
retired_controls.observed: The current closure preserves the prior disposition; superseded entries still point to active passed replacements and not-applicable entries remain outside the current canonical risk requirements.
retired_controls.reason: This historical control belongs to an earlier encoding/risk-manifest delivery and is retained in lineage without becoming a second active authority for the current training-flow remediation.
